description: Single-panel colour photograph, not a scientific figure. It shows a head-and-shoulders studio portrait of a man with short brown hair and a trimmed full beard, facing the camera with a neutral expression. He wears a dark (black or very dark navy) suit jacket, a white collared shirt and a dark necktie. The background is a diffuse, out-of-focus blue field with lighter mottling, typical of a corporate or institutional backdrop. In the upper-right corner of the frame there is a white emblem and partial white text reading "OF UKRAINE"; the emblem and wording are cropped by the image edge, so the full logo text is unreadable. No axes, no scale bar, no legend, no sample label, no composition or processing annotation and no microstructural or metallurgical content are present anywhere in the image. There is no caption supplied for this figure. The image cannot be reconciled with the surrounding paper on lightweight Fe–Mn–Al–C steels: it contains no micrograph, spectrum, curve, map, table, schematic or specimen view, and it provides no evidence bearing on alloying effects, κ-carbide formation or mechanical properties. It appears to be a mismatched or placeholder photograph rather than a data figure.
